THIS APPEAL COMING ON FOR ADMISSION, THIS DAY,
JUDGMENT WAS DELIVERED THEREIN AS UNDER:
CORAM: HON'BLE MRS JUSTICE P SREE SUDHA  ORAL JUDGMENT 1.

This appeal is filed by the claimant against the Judgment and award dated 21.04.2021 passed in MVC No.1212/2018 by the I Additional Senior Civil Judge and MACT, Kalaburagi (for short 'the tribunal') seeking enhancement of the compensation.

entities.text: I Additional Senior Civil Judge and
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 2. The claimant aged 25 years, doing coloring work to the buildings met with accident on 14.04.2017 and sustained grievous injuries.
He filed claim petition before the tribunal seeking compensation of Rs.39,15,000/-.

The tribunal after considering the entire evidence on record, awarded a sum of Rs.5,20,400/- along with interest at the rate of 6% per annum from the date of petition till NC:
2025:KHC-K:7426 HC-KAR realization.

Being aggrieved by the said Judgment and award the claimant preferred the present appeal and mainly contended that, the claimant was earning a sum of Rs.22,500/- per month and he sustained multiple injuries.
The claimant examined the Doctor.
The Doctor assessed the disability of the claimant at 37% to the whole body, but the tribunal has considered only 10%.
The claimant has filed medical bills to the tune of Rs.4,41,137/-, but the tribunal has awarded only Rs.2,48,300/- towards medical expenditure.
Further it is stated that, the amounts granted under other heads are also meager and requests for enhancement of the compensation.
3. Per contra, learned counsel for the respondent- Insurance company contended that, the tribunal has rightly granted the medical expenses and it needs no interference.
The claimant has not produced any income proof to prove his income.
Hence, he requests to dismiss the appeal.
4. Heard the arguments from both sides.

The claimant has met with accident in the year 2017.
Hence, his notional income is to be taken at Rs.10,250/- per month as per the guidelines of the Karnataka State Legal Services Authority.
The claimant was aged 28 years as per Ex.P.15-Bank passbook copy.
The multiplier is to be taken at '17'.
As per Ex.P.5 - wound certificate the claimant sustained fracture of right IMA, which is grievous in nature.
The claimant examined the Doctor as P.W.2 and he issued disability certificate marked at Ex.P.8.

In the disability certificate it is mentioned that, CT scan of cervical vertebrae and brain was done; it revealed fracture greater wing of sphenoid bone reaching R-zygomatic arch and squamous temporal bone extending into condylar fossa on left side through middle ear, contusion in right temporal lobe, SAH in bilateral parietal region and diffuse cerebral edema and midline shift.
The Doctor has assessed the disability of the claimant at 37% to the whole body, but the tribunal has considered only 10%.
Learned counsel for the respondent-Insurance company contend that, the Doctor i.e. P.W.2 is not a treated Doctor and he is not competent to NC: 2025:KHC-K:7426 HC-KAR assess the disability.

However, considering the evidence of P.W.2, the disability of 1/3rd of 37%
would comes to 12%.
But looking into the disability certificate this Court finds it reasonable to consider 15% disability to the whole body.
The claimant was hospitalized for 15 days as per Ex.P.7- discharge card.

Loss of future earning capacity is as under:
Rs.10,250/- X 12 X 17 X 15% = Rs.3,13,650/-.
6.
As per Ex.P.11, the tribunal has awarded a sum of Rs.2,48,300/- towards medical expenses and it needs no interference.

Considering the nature of injuries, age, occupation and injuries suffered by the claimant and also other relevant factor, this Court finds it reasonable to award a sum of Rs.50,000/- towards medical expenses, Rs.25,000/- towards loss of amenities and Rs.30,000/-
towards transportation, extra nourishment and attendant charges.
He might have not attended any other work for at least four months.
Hence, a sum of Rs.41,000/- (Rs.10,250/- X 4 months) towards loss of income during laid up period.

Hence, the total compensation is as under:

7. Learned counsel for the Insurance company submits that, the compensation amount awarded by the tribunal has been deposited before the tribunal.
